{{Quote|Of course not, Lieutenant. It was my illustrious and so widely mourned predecessor who signed the accord with the New Republic. I did not. My loyalty is with Zsinj&hellip;even if practical circumstances prevent me from declaring it publicly at this time.|Nojin Koolb to Garik Loran|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''Nojin Koolb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xartun]] during [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

==Biography==
Shortly after the [[Bacta War]], Koolb entered into an agreement with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] for protection, despite [[Xartun]] being recent signatory to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He assured [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Garik Loran]], who was undercover pretending to be a subordinate of Zsinj, that his loyalty was to the warlord.<ref name="WS" />
